3833.title: Unsupported plan requests dispatch normally
3833.rootCauseOneLine: CLI plan encoding is unconditional, and the server omits unsupported plan mode without rejecting the structured request.
3833.proposedFix: Validate plan capability at request acceptance for the resolved provider, before dispatch or queueing.
3833.caveats: Repeated command-builder reproduction; no live model or UI run. Assessed complete fix exceeds the five-file automation limit.
